title: Correlate an SDDC Manager task failure with events and support logs
prompt:
Complete `VcfFailureDiagnosticsClient.java` as a single-file Java 17, standard-library-only client for VMware Cloud Foundation 9.1 SDDC Manager. Operators currently have only a failed task's generic summary; the workflow must retrieve task evidence, retrieve resource notifications, collect focused support logs, and correlate all three before reporting a cause.

Before implementing, research the `getTask`, `getNotifications`, `startSupportBundle`, `getSupportBundleStatus`, and `exportSupportBundleByID` operations in the SDDC Manager OpenAPI specification in VMware's Apache-2.0 `vmware/vcf-api-specs` repository and cite the specification URLs consulted. Do not contact any other SDDC Manager route.

Preserve the public constructor, records, and `diagnoseTaskFailure` signature already declared in the client and implement these rules:

- Use only Java 17 standard-library APIs. Construction performs no traffic. The base URI must be an HTTP(S) origin without credentials, query, fragment, or a non-root path. Reject a blank or whitespace-bearing access token, `maxPollAttempts < 1`, and a null, zero, or negative request timeout before traffic. Do not follow redirects.
- Validate a nonblank task ID with no surrounding whitespace before traffic. Invoke `getTask` as exactly `GET /v1/tasks/{id}`, encoding the ID as one UTF-8 path segment. Send no query, body, `Content-Type`, transfer encoding, or empty query delimiter. Accept exactly HTTP 200 `application/json` and require the documented Task strings. The returned ID must equal the requested ID, and status must normalize to `FAILED`. Require at least one Task resource with its required nonblank `resourceId` and `type`, and at least one Task error with a nonblank `referenceToken`. A non-failed or malformed task stops the workflow without collecting unrelated evidence.
- Next invoke `getNotifications` as exactly `GET /v1/notifications`, with the same GET wire rules, and accept exactly HTTP 200 `application/json`. A notification is relevant when one of its resource IDs equals a failed-task resource ID. Preserve relevant notifications in server order and require at least one relevant notification with a nonblank `message.id`; unrelated notifications cannot provide correlation.
- Invoke `startSupportBundle` as exactly `POST /v1/system/support-bundles`, with no query. Send the compact UTF-8 body `{"logs":{"sddcManagerLogs":true,"apiLogs":true}}` and `Content-Type: application/json`; accept exactly HTTP 202 `application/json` and require a nonblank bundle ID. `SupportBundleSpec`, `Logs`, and every nested property are optional in the documented schema. Therefore `options`, `scope`, and every unselected log field must be omitted rather than sent as null, false, an empty object, an empty string, or any other placeholder.
- Poll `getSupportBundleStatus` as exactly `GET /v1/system/support-bundles/{id}`, encoding the bundle ID as one path segment. Poll at least once and at most `maxPollAttempts` times. `PENDING` and `IN_PROGRESS` continue, `COMPLETED_WITH_SUCCESS` proceeds, `COMPLETED_WITH_FAILURE` fails, and any unknown or malformed status fails. Each response must be HTTP 200 `application/json` with the same bundle ID.
- After successful collection, invoke `exportSupportBundleByID` as exactly `GET /v1/system/support-bundles/{id}/data`, accept exactly HTTP 200 `application/octet-stream`, and safely inspect the gzip-compressed tar without extracting it. Enforce limits of 32 MiB compressed, 128 entries, 32 MiB per relevant file, and 32 MiB total expanded relevant log data. Reject unsafe archive paths and malformed or truncated archives. Ignore non-regular entries and skip non-`.log` members before reading file data.
- Parse each regular `.log` member as one complete UTF-8 JSON document and traverse nested objects recursively. Report only a unique task object whose `id` equals the requested task and whose nested `errors` contains an object with a failed-task `referenceToken` plus nonblank `errorCode` and `message`. Return the native error message, the first relevant notification message ID in server order, and the archive path with the task ID, relevant events, and bundle ID. If no unique task-and-reference-token record correlates, fail instead of guessing from task text, an event alone, or an unrelated log object. Returned collections must be unmodifiable.
- Every JSON request sends exactly `Accept: application/json` and `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`; the archive request uses `Accept: application/octet-stream` plus the bearer header. Unexpected HTTP status, media type, response shape, terminal state, poll exhaustion, or archive evidence is an `IOException`. Preserve `InterruptedException`. Exception messages must not expose the bearer token, response body, task reference token, notification content, or log cause.

Do not modify `tests/`; edit only `VcfFailureDiagnosticsClient.java`. Run `python3 tests/verify.py`.
scenario: a failed SDDC Manager task whose cause can only be reported after correlating its reference token, a resource notification, and a downloaded support-log record
